figurative_meaning_en: Synonymous reduplicative word; repeated tearing or tearing into pieces
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই চিঠিটা ছেঁড়াছিঁড়ি করে ফেলো না।
example_sentences_in_english: Don't tear this letter to shreds.
His shirt is all torn up.
note: This is a common reduplicative form in Bengali for emphasizing repeated action or state of disrepair.
